strings.任务依赖、队员容量与会话租约均在运行范围内。: Task dependencies, member capacity and session leases are all within limits.
strings.总览只显示当前队员与任务信号，详细协作状态集中在双队菜单。: The overview shows only current member and task signals; detailed collaboration lives under Two teams.

strings.只拆解、派发、汇总和巡检: Only decompose, dispatch, summarize and patrol

strings.共享池保留成员与外包位；总览负责当前工作指标，双队负责队伍分配和并发控制。: The shared pool keeps member and contractor slots; Overview owns current-work metrics and Two teams owns allocation and concurrency control.
strings.有待批准消息时展开 · 未批准不可见: Expand when messages await approval · unapproved messages stay hidden
strings.规则：A/B 只能通过邮箱联系；未批准的消息不可见、不可用，不能绕过队长；消息经: Rule: A/B communicate only through the mailbox; unapproved messages are invisible and unusable, cannot bypass the captain, and are delivered only after captain approval.
strings.队员按任务难度动态借调，不固定切成 3+3。: Members are borrowed by task difficulty, never split into a fixed 3+3.
strings.只在确有消息时打开低频审批区。: Open the low-frequency approval area only when messages actually exist.
strings.实线为已完成/进行中的队内依赖；虚线为跨队交付或队内等待依赖；拖动只调整布局，不: Solid lines are completed/in-progress in-team dependencies; dashed lines are cross-team handoffs or waiting in-team dependencies; dragging changes layout only, never task relationships
strings.实线为队内依赖；虚线为队内等待依赖；拖动只调整布局，不改变任务关系: Solid lines are in-team dependencies; dashed lines are waiting in-team dependencies; dragging changes layout only, never task relationships

strings.虚线：跨队交付或队内等待: Dashed: cross-team handoff or waiting in-team dependency
strings.复位视图：恢复任务树初始视角: Reset view: restore the task tree initial view
strings.点击任务块打开详情 · Esc 关闭详情并清除高亮: Click a task card to open details · Esc closes details and clears focus
strings.等待接入实时会话。接入后由 daemon 把该任务的对话内容实时同步到这里。: Waiting for the live session. Once connected, the daemon streams this task’s conversation here in real time.
strings.名称与共享池一致 · 代号不可更改 · 内部 ID 不显示: Names match the shared pool · codes never change · internal IDs stay hidden
strings.会话内容由系统提供，控制台只展示任务与事件数据: Session content is provided by the system; the console shows only task and event data
strings.号牌历史由系统维护，控制台只读展示: Badge history is maintained by the system; the console only displays it
strings.代号由系统生成，永远不变；号牌由系统按结算状态自动更换，控制台只读展示。: Codes are generated by the system and never change; badges rotate automatically by settlement state, and the console only displays them read-only.

strings.审核员签合并单，合并执行员只执行，合并后由外包审查员复核: A reviewer signs the merge order, the merge operator only executes, and a contractor auditor rechecks afterwards
strings.独立审核通过后才进入待执行队列。: Only an independent review pass enters the execution queue.
strings.不改代码；冲突不强制解决，回滚并驳回。: No code changes; conflicts are never forced, the change is rolled back and rejected.
strings.一次性只读审查，结果写回审计。: One-off read-only audit; the result is written back to the audit log.
strings.合并员不改代码: The merge operator does not change code
strings.合并员不改代码 · 冲突时自动回滚: The merge operator does not change code · conflicts roll back automatically
strings.实时视图只读，不能合并: The live view is read-only; merging is disabled
strings.后置审查未通过，暂不能合并: Post-review has not passed; merging is not available yet
strings.没有多改文件或夹带提交: No extra files or smuggled commits
strings.队长空闲时自己巡检；队长忙时交给一次性巡检工，扫完即关: captain patrols when free; when busy, a one-off patrol contractor scans and shuts down immediately

strings.系统未提供合并队列: Merge queue not provided by the system
strings.系统未提供巡检发现: Patrol findings not provided by the system

strings.系统会在巡检发现异常时写入这里。: The system writes here when patrol finds an anomaly.
strings.剩余 4 次 / 小时 · 仅异常时唤醒 AI: 4 left / hour · wakes AI only on anomalies
strings.只追加，不可修改 · 任务、号牌、合并、巡检全部留痕: Append-only, immutable · tasks, badges, merges and patrols all leave a trail
strings.系统未提供审计事件: Audit events not provided by the system
strings.系统未提供事件数据: Event data not provided by the system

strings.系统未提供待审批状态: Approval state not provided by the system

strings.系统会在需要队长判断时自动进入邮箱。: The system routes a message to the mailbox when the captain must decide.
strings.系统未提供邮箱状态: Mailbox state not provided by the system
strings.快照不包含待审批消息。: The snapshot contains no pending messages.
strings.跨队消息由系统自动提交队长判断。: Cross-team messages are submitted to the captain automatically.
strings.系统当前策略；控制台只读，业务动作由 captain/daemon 自动判断: Current system policy; the console is read-only and captain/daemon decides business actions automatically

strings.日常动作自动执行。高风险操作由 captain 判定；完全访问会关闭所有审批并锁: Routine actions run automatically. The captain decides high-risk operations; Full access disables all approvals and locks settings.

strings.任务派发、换号牌、创建团队自动: Task dispatch, badge changes and team creation are automatic
strings.设置锁定 · 审计/硬停保留: Settings locked · audit and hard stop remain
strings.完全访问已开启：所有审批默认通过，设置不可修改。退出后才能调整。: Full access is on: every approval passes by default and settings cannot be changed. Exit it to adjust them.
strings.实时快照只读；容量由系统配置，双队按任务难度动态抽调。: The live snapshot is read-only; capacity comes from system configuration and Two teams borrows workers by task difficulty.
strings.只对这些操作由 captain 判定；普通派发、创建团队、换号牌默认自动。: Only these operations are decided by the captain; normal dispatch, team creation and badge changes are automatic by default.
strings.达到系统设置的任务回合上限后暂停一次，防止全自动跑飞；完全访问模式下忽略。它不是: Pauses once the system task-round limit is reached to prevent runaway automation; ignored in Full access. It is not a token limit.
strings.完全访问会关闭所有审批并锁定设置。确定开启吗？: Full access disables all approvals and locks settings. Turn it on?
strings.已回到标准模式：只有高风险需要确认: Back to Standard: only high-risk actions need confirmation
strings.完全访问已自动批准，对方邮箱可见: Full access auto-approved it; the other mailbox can see it
strings.完全访问：跨队消息已自动批准并投递。审计、预算硬上限和硬停仍然有效。: Full access: cross-team messages were auto-approved and delivered. Audit, budget caps and hard stop still apply.

strings.已驳回，消息未投递: Rejected; the message was not delivered
strings.规则：A/B 只能通过邮箱联系；跨队消息由系统提交队长判断，未批准的消息对方不可: Rule: A/B communicate only through the mailbox; cross-team messages go to the captain automatically, and unapproved messages stay invisible to the other side. The console shows state only and offers no manual approval.
